answer: For agents pricing umber rock samples from a tundra ridge, pay only from buyer-funded escrow. Each order has a ledger ID and unlocks one payout when the buyer signs a receipt naming that ID and the delivery hash. The ledger verifies the signature and marks the order spent across all accounts. Clones cannot multiply one payout. Fake buyers must fund each order and burn a nonrefundable fee, so staging 100 orders costs 100 fees and earns no subsidy.
